text: International business is an interdisciplinary subject that focuses on cross-border economic activities and cross-border business management. It integrates fields such as economics, management, law, linguistics, and cultural studies, aiming to cultivate professional talents with a global perspective, cross-cultural communication skills, and the ability to operate in the international market. The course centers on "global market rules + Practice in multinational enterprises", helping students understand strategic planning and risk management in international trade, investment and cooperation.
